# Pendor reference

> Static extracted data from Prophesy of Pendor QoL Plus v2. This index does not describe the current save or in-game availability.

- [Explorer home](/game-reference/pendor/): Overview and section navigation.
- [Troop explorer](/game-reference/pendor/troops/): Search all 1203 troop definitions.
- [Item explorer](/game-reference/pendor/items/): Search all 1573 item definitions.
- [Comparison tables](/game-reference/pendor/tables/): Query all 1,203 troop and 1,573 item definitions.
- [Companion relationships](/game-reference/pendor/companions/): Browse 20 companion profiles and a directed assignment matrix.
- [Roster comparison](/game-reference/pendor/roster/): Count initial assignments within a manually selected set of companions.
